headlines.FAIL: This scan cannot be used. Please scan the room again.

MISSING_MANIFEST.title: Scan is incomplete
MISSING_MANIFEST.text: The scan did not finish saving.

ARCHIVE_UNREADABLE.title: Scan file is damaged
ARCHIVE_UNREADABLE.text: The scan's packed file could not be opened safely.

MANIFEST_SCHEMA.title: Scan data is damaged
MANIFEST_SCHEMA.text: The scan's summary file is not readable.

UNSUPPORTED_MAJOR.title: App update needed
UNSUPPORTED_MAJOR.text: This scan was made by a newer version of the app.
UNSUPPORTED_MAJOR.action: Update the app, then open the scan again.

UNKNOWN_MINOR.title: Newer scan format
UNKNOWN_MINOR.text: This scan uses newer, optional data we do not know yet.

CONSENT_MISSING.title: Consent record missing
CONSENT_MISSING.text: The scan has no record that the person scanning accepted the capture terms.
CONSENT_MISSING.action: Accept the terms in the app, then scan the room again.

REDACTION_MANIFEST_MISSING.title: Privacy record missing
REDACTION_MANIFEST_MISSING.text: The scan has no record of how faces were blurred.

CAMERA_SCHEMA.title: Camera data is damaged
CAMERA_SCHEMA.text: The camera description is missing or invalid.

MISSING_FILE.title: Scan is missing files
MISSING_FILE.text: Some files of the scan are missing.

MCAP_TRUNCATED.title: Scan stopped early
MCAP_TRUNCATED.action: Scan the room again; keep the app open until it says done.

MCAP_UNREADABLE.title: Scan data is damaged
MCAP_UNREADABLE.text: The motion recording cannot be read.

MISSING_CHANNEL.title: Sensor data missing
MISSING_CHANNEL.text: A required sensor recording is missing (poses, motion or camera info).
MISSING_CHANNEL.action: Scan again and allow camera and motion access.

SHA256_MISMATCH.title: Scan data changed
SHA256_MISMATCH.text: A file does not match its checksum, so it was damaged or edited.

SIZE_MISMATCH.title: Scan data changed
SIZE_MISMATCH.text: A file has a different size than recorded.

REDACTION_ENTRY_BAD_PATH.title: Odd privacy log entry
REDACTION_ENTRY_BAD_PATH.text: The privacy log names a file outside the photo folder; it is ignored.

REDACTION_ENTRY_NO_FILE.title: Blurred photo not saved
REDACTION_ENTRY_NO_FILE.text: The privacy log lists a photo that was not saved.

UNLISTED_FILE.title: Extra file in scan
UNLISTED_FILE.text: The scan contains a file that is not listed.

NON_MONOTONIC_TIME.title: Timing error
NON_MONOTONIC_TIME.text: Timestamps go backwards, so frames cannot be matched to poses.

NAN_VALUE.title: Invalid sensor values
NAN_VALUE.text: Some sensor readings are not valid numbers.
NAN_VALUE.action: Scan again; if it repeats, restart the phone.

TIME_ZERO.title: Timing error at the start
TIME_ZERO.text: The first camera position or camera info has no valid time, so frames cannot be matched to poses.
TIME_ZERO.action: Scan the room again; if it repeats, restart the app.

NON_UNIT_QUATERNION.title: Invalid camera rotations
NON_UNIT_QUATERNION.text: Some camera rotations are not valid.

MISSING_INTRINSICS.title: Camera info missing
MISSING_INTRINSICS.text: Camera lens information is missing for the first photos.

KEYFRAME_WITHOUT_POSE.title: Photos without position
KEYFRAME_WITHOUT_POSE.text: Some photos have no tracked camera position.
KEYFRAME_WITHOUT_POSE.action: Scan again, moving slowly while tracking is good.

KEYFRAME_FILE_MISSING.title: Photos are missing
KEYFRAME_FILE_MISSING.text: The scan lists photos that were not saved.
KEYFRAME_FILE_MISSING.action: Scan the room again; make sure storage is not full.

COUNT_MISMATCH.title: Counts differ
COUNT_MISMATCH.text: Summary counts differ slightly from the recording.
COUNT_MISMATCH.action: Nothing. The recording is used as is.

KEYFRAME_TRACKING_LIMITED.title: Shaky tracking in places
KEYFRAME_TRACKING_LIMITED.text: Some photos were taken while tracking was weak.
KEYFRAME_TRACKING_LIMITED.action: Optional: rescan those areas slowly with more light.

POSE_GAP.title: Tracking was lost briefly
POSE_GAP.text: Tracking was interrupted for part of the scan.
POSE_GAP.action: Optional: rescan the area where tracking was lost.

NO_KEYFRAMES.title: No photos were saved
NO_KEYFRAMES.text: The scan contains no usable photos, so no 3D result can be made.
NO_KEYFRAMES.action: Scan the room again; walk slowly and keep the app open until it says done.

FEW_KEYFRAMES.title: Not many photos
FEW_KEYFRAMES.text: The scan has few usable photos, so the 3D result may have gaps.
FEW_KEYFRAMES.action: Walk the room again, slower, covering all walls.

NO_AR_GEOMETRY.title: No surface hints
NO_AR_GEOMETRY.text: The phone did not report surfaces or feature points.

DETECTION_BAD_BOX.title: Odd object boxes
DETECTION_BAD_BOX.text: Some detected object boxes are not valid.

DETECTION_UNKNOWN_FRAME.title: Detections without photo
DETECTION_UNKNOWN_FRAME.text: Some object detections refer to photos that are not in the scan.

GUIDE_OUTPUT_BAD_VALUE.title: Odd room labels
GUIDE_OUTPUT_BAD_VALUE.text: Some room outline, object or gap data in the scan is not valid.

LABEL_WALL_UNKNOWN.title: Door or window without wall
LABEL_WALL_UNKNOWN.text: A door or window refers to a wall that is not in the room outline.

PARTIAL_BUNDLE.title: Scan was cut short
PARTIAL_BUNDLE.text: The scan was interrupted and recovered, so part of the room may be missing.

QUALITY_NOT_EVALUATED.title: Quality not checked
QUALITY_NOT_EVALUATED.text: Quality metrics were not available for this scan.
